column1: # Migration files that were applied to production by hand before their file reached main.
# supabase-deploy.yml does not run a file listed here; it checks the proof against the live
# database and fails the run when the proof is missing. Columns are tab-separated: file, proof.
#   history=<name>   a row with that name exists in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations
#   relation=<name>  that table or view exists
#   routine=<name>   that function exists (for a file that only defines functions and has no
#                    history row; weaker: it shows the function is present, not which body)
# Add a line only for a file whose effects were verified live. 2026-11-11: every function these
# files define was compared, body for body, with pg_proc; each is either the live body or an
# older body that a later file in this list replaced.
